name: 92649 · Huntingtn Bch, CA
findings: ZIP 92649 (Huntingtn Bch) has 178 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92649 (Huntingtn Bch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
